items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear, but the non-obvious heuristic `len(key_transform) <= 3 and key_transform.isdigit()` in compile_json_path has no comment explaining why it exists. The nested isinstance condition is hard to follow.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: KeyTransformIsNull.as_oracle/as_sqlite now hand-build the JSON_EXISTS/JSON_TYPE SQL instead of reusing HasKey, which duplicates logic. There is no overridable final-key hook, and KeyTransformExact.as_oracle was left inconsistent with the new HasKey behaviour.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The magic constant `<= 3` decides whether a digit string is an array index or an object key. This silently mis-handles index '1234' and object key '12' in intermediate paths. No errors are swallowed.

items.name: Array-index semantics kept for isnull / exact=None paths
items.name_zh: isnull / exact=None 路径保留数组下标语义
items.evidence: compile_json_path changes globally through digit-length string munging, so value__1000__... no longer addresses an array element. KeyTransformExact.as_oracle still calls HasKey, which now forces an object key, so value__d__0=None breaks on Oracle.
